_notes: Card acquisition (docs/design/acquisition.md, owner-approved 2026-11-08). A tier is how hard a card is to get, never its power (stats stay in sects.json). starter: owned by every account; homeStarterRoles: the home sect's cards of these roles are owned too (the sect picked on first run, เลือกสำนักแรก). homeRoleCards maps a sect and a role to its card id, so campaign.json can reward {homeRole}. starterTeam: the roles of the home sect a new account leads with. A card's route is, in order: starter, a campaign.json stage's rewards.firstClear, chapterStars of a chapter that exists, else the egg shop. plannedRoutes: the designed route of cards whose chapter or mode is not built yet (chapters 2-3, achievements, the casual league); until it exists the card is sold in the egg shop at its tier price, and the collection view shows both. eggShop: a card is bought by choice with egg points (castleLevel.levels[].eggPoints, chapterStars and campaign rewards; never sold) once opensAfterStage is won and the castle reaches its tier's eggShopFromCastleLevel; there is no rotation and no hatch timer. Buying an owned card is a training egg: the card gains its tier's dupeXp. duplicates.campaignOwned: a campaign card reward the player already owns pays its tier's egg price in egg points instead. The hand is picked, never drawn (SPEC-deck-budget, battle.json deck): an account picks from the cards it owns, and borrows battle.json deck.loaners when it owns fewer than 6 non-basic cards. rankedPool: ranked ศึกฝีมือ picks from every card here, whatever the account owns (normalized stats). debut: a new card's first weeks (Season 1 on).
